title: Vertical FAQ Timeline
description: A vertical timeline tracking product ownership milestones from unboxing care to 5-year maintenance.
heading: Product Ownership Timeline
subtitle: Recommended care steps across the life of your product.

questions.question: Unboxing & Initial Steaming
questions.answer: Unpack immediately and hang on a sturdy wooden hanger. Allow 24 hours for shipping creases to relax, or use a gentle garment steamer.

questions.question: First Seasonal Service
questions.answer: After your first winter of wear, dry clean once and apply a cedar garment bag for seasonal storage.

questions.question: DWR Coating Refresh
questions.answer: Re-apply a spray-on waterproof DWR treatment to outer shell fabric after 15 to 20 wear cycles.
